dedupe_keys.name: interviews with eu port authorities to co create solutions to promote and implement best practices regarding waste management

description: NETTAG+ researchers publish anonymised interviews with port authorities in Croatia, Italy, Malta, Portugal and Spain. The July 2026 ZIP download covers fisheries waste handling, disposal, marine-litter prevention, participation by fishers and preferred incentives for a possible rewards programme. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. The responses can inform actor rules or institutional constraints in simulations of port-waste services and fishing-related material flows. They are qualitative interview evidence, not measured waste volumes or a statistically representative census of European ports. Interview dates, respondent counts, coding structure and internal file formats remain unknown from the public description. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this interview collection. The archive was not downloaded, and neither representativeness nor the practical effect of the proposed incentives was independently assessed.
